## Post-release PR review

`review-post-release-pr` can automatically approve `nextflow.config` changes
when only the quoted `version` value in a top-level `manifest` block is updated
to the release version followed by `-dev` (without the tag's leading `v`).
All other configuration content must remain unchanged. Unrecognized or
ambiguous manifest layouts require human review.

The version file must still be bumped, and all other post-release checks must
pass. If automatic approval is skipped, the bot comments with the reasons and
requests a human reviewer to review and approve or update the PR.
